Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1979
WEALTH TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Wealth Tax Act, 1963
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Wealth Tax Act, 1963 (XV of 1973), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the President is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July 1917, read with the Laws (Continuance
in Eorce) Order, 1977 [C.M.L.A. Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all
powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance, namely :‑
1. Short title, extent and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Wealth Tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
(3) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the twenty‑eighth day of
June 1979.

Amendment of section 5, Act XV of 1963

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 1979
WEALTH TAX (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Wealth Tax Act, 1963
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 18th August 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Wealth Tax Act, 1963 (XV of 1973), for the purpose hereinafter
appearing;
And whereas the President is
satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to take immediate
action;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of the fifth day of July 1917, read with the Laws (Continuance
in Eorce) Order, 1977 [C.M.L.A. Order No. 1 of 1977), and in exercise of all
powers enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make and
promulgate the following Ordinance, namely :‑
2. Amendment of section 5, Act XV of 1963.‑In the Wealth Tax
Act, 1963 (XV of 1963), in section 5, in subsection (1) for clause (xvi) the
following shall be substituted, namely :‑
"(xvi) so much of the market
value of immovable property, excluding agricultural land, as does not exceed
rupees five lakhs, or, at the option of the assessee, one house; irrespective
of its value, used by the assessee and the spouse and dependent children of the
assessee as their own residence;"
